name: Countermeasures
description: This modification adds a series of countermeasures to the ship, granting it a more active approach to ward off effects. Once per round, when your ship is forced to make a saving throw against an effect that would cause it to be blinded, ionized, shocked, stalled, stunned, or tractored a crewmember can use their reaction to add the ship's Wisdom modifier to the roll (minimum of +1).
